readerJob: Decide whether a Netherlands-based creator should buy the compact iPad mini A20 Pro for field review, notes, sketching and light edits, or choose a phone, larger iPad or laptop because of screen size, iPadOS application limits, storage-tier chip differences and accessory cost.
decision: Do not issue a buying recommendation yet. Apple establishes exact Dutch Wi-Fi and cellular models, meaningful storage-tier chip differences and a November 6 availability date, but official specifications do not establish application fit, sustained editing performance, field endurance, display accuracy or whether the compact form replaces any device in a real creator workflow.
wrongPurchaseConditions: The buyer needs a desktop-only application, plug-in, file workflow or peripheral that is unavailable or materially constrained on iPadOS.
The buyer expects the 128 GB or 256 GB configuration to have the same CPU and Neural Engine configuration as the 512 GB model.
The buyer needs a laptop-class keyboard, multi-port connectivity or more than one external display without adding accessories and carrying cost.
The buyer expects the 12 MP rear camera to replace a current high-end phone or dedicated camera without exact-device comparison evidence.
The buyer needs independently verified colour accuracy, sustained performance, battery endurance or outdoor visibility rather than manufacturer specifications.
The buyer can already complete the named capture, review and annotation workflow on a phone, larger iPad or existing laptop.
The buyer treats IP67 as permission for intentional underwater use or ignores that resistance can diminish over time.
evidenceLevel: official Apple Netherlands launch, specification and legal evidence; no hands-on testing

claims.text: Apple Netherlands dates the launch October 26, 2026, says pre-orders opened October 28 and states availability begins November 6.
claims.allowedWording: Attribute the dates to Apple and recheck availability before publication.

claims.text: Apple Netherlands lists 128 GB, 256 GB and 512 GB capacities in midnight and starlight, starting at EUR 759 for Wi-Fi and EUR 929 for Wi-Fi plus Cellular.
claims.allowedWording: Use only with date, region and family starting-price context; otherwise omit.

claims.text: Apple specifies an 8.5-inch OLED display with 2316-by-1512 resolution, 326 ppi, up to 600 nits SDR and full-screen XDR brightness, and up to 1200 nits peak for HDR content.
claims.allowedWording: Preserve Apple attribution and brightness conditions; do not call display accuracy independently verified.

claims.text: Apple specifies 5.4 mm thickness, 255 g for Wi-Fi and 263 g for Wi-Fi plus Cellular, and an IP67 rating under IEC 60529.
claims.allowedWording: Treat carry comfort and field durability as untested; do not recommend intentional water exposure.

claims.text: Apple identifies A3595 as the Wi-Fi model and A3596 as the Wi-Fi plus Cellular model on the Dutch specification page.
claims.allowedWording: Name connectivity and model number together; do not apply these identifiers to another region.

claims.text: Apple lists a 5-core CPU and 16-core Neural Engine for 128 GB and 256 GB, but a 6-core CPU and Dual 16-core Neural Engine for 512 GB; all list a 7-core GPU.
claims.allowedWording: Keep the storage-tier boundary explicit; do not infer a measured performance delta.

claims.text: Apple specifies USB 3 up to 10 Gb/s and support for one external display up to 4K at 60 Hz.
claims.allowedWording: Do not infer compatibility with an untested drive, dock, capture device or display.

claims.text: Apple specifies up to 10 hours of Wi-Fi web or video use and up to 9 hours of cellular web use.
claims.allowedWording: Use Apple's exact test categories; do not convert them into creator-workflow endurance.

claims.text: Apple specifies a 12 MP wide rear camera with 4K recording up to 60 fps, a landscape 12 MP Center Stage front camera, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and Apple Pencil Pro support.
claims.allowedWording: Use as specification fit only; do not claim camera, radio or Pencil workflow quality without testing.

claims.text: Apple positions the device for creative users and claims A20 Pro performance benefits, but no independent creator benchmark or workflow test was collected.
claims.allowedWording: Keep Apple attribution and do not convert positioning into an independent recommendation.

claims.text: Apple's Dutch site terms and intellectual-property guidance do not grant commercial republication of Apple-owned product images without express permission.
claims.allowedWording: Keep Apple imagery quarantined unless a per-asset permission receipt is recorded; credit is not permission.
